title: Data Engineer
description: A job-focused roadmap for building reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, warehouses, orchestration, and analytics-ready datasets.

tree.name: Foundational Skills for Data Engineers
tree.description: Establish a robust base in programming, databases, version control, operating systems, and core data concepts essential for any data engineer.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (12 hours) (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Python Programming Essentials
children.description: Master Python fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, functional programming, OOP basics, error handling, and writing clean, modular code. Introduce relevant libraries like Pandas, NumPy, and requests for data manipulation and API interaction.

resources.title: Effective Python: 90 Specific Ways to Write Better Python
Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners [Tutorial]

children.name: Advanced SQL & Relational Databases
children.description: Deepen SQL proficiency with complex queries, window functions, CTEs, performance optimization (indexing, query plans), transactions, and understand RDBMS concepts (ACID, normalization, denormalization). Work with popular RDBMS like PostgreSQL or MySQL.

resources.title: SQL Window Functions Tutorial - FULL COURSE for Beginners & Advanced Users

children.name: Version Control with Git
children.description: Learn Git for collaborative development, including branching strategies (GitFlow, GitHub Flow), merging, rebasing, pull requests, resolving conflicts, and managing code repositories.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Linux & Shell Scripting Basics
children.description: Familiarize with Linux command line for navigating file systems, managing permissions, common utilities (grep, sed, awk), process management, and writing basic shell scripts for automating data-related tasks.

resources.title: Linux Command Line Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Networking & OS Fundamentals
children.description: Understand fundamental networking concepts (TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, Load Balancing) and operating system principles (processes, threads, memory management, file systems, I/O) crucial for distributed systems, cloud computing, and troubleshooting data infrastructure.

resources.title: Computer Networking Course - Network Fundamentals for Beginners
Operating Systems Full Course | Operating System Tutorial for Beginners

tree.name: Data Modeling & Warehousing
tree.description: Learn to design efficient and robust data models for analytical workloads and understand the architecture of modern data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouses.

resources.title: Database Design Course - Learn to create a database from scratch
Data Warehousing Tutorial for Beginners | Data Warehousing Concepts | Data Engineering | Simplilearn

children.name: Dimensional Modeling & Schema Design
children.description: Master dimensional modeling concepts: facts, dimensions, slowly changing dimensions (SCDs Type 1-3), star/snowflake schemas, and data vault modeling for creating analytics-friendly and scalable data warehouses. Understand surrogate keys and grain.

resources.title: What is Dimensional Modeling? Star Schema & Snowflake Schema | Data Warehousing Tutorial | Simplilearn

children.name: Data Lake & Data Lakehouse Architectures
children.description: Understand the concepts and evolution of data lakes, optimal storage strategies (e.g., separating raw, processed, curated zones), and the emerging data lakehouse paradigm with platforms and open formats like Delta Lake, Apache Hudi, or Apache Iceberg.

resources.title: Data Lake vs Data Warehouse Explained (What's the Difference?)
Data Lakehouse Architecture Explained | Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi

children.name: Cloud Data Warehouses Deep Dive
children.description: Dive deeper into leading cloud data warehouse solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, Azure Synapse Analytics), exploring their architecture, columnar storage, query optimization, cost management, and security features.

resources.title: What is a Data Warehouse? Explained in simple terms
Cloud Data Warehouses Explained: BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift & Synapse Analytics

children.name: NoSQL Databases Concepts
children.description: Explore various NoSQL database types (Key-Value, Document, Column-Family, Graph) and their use cases in data engineering, understanding their strengths and weaknesses compared to RDBMS (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, DynamoDB).

children.name: Data Marts & Data Virtualization
children.description: Understand the role and design of data marts for focused analytical needs. Explore data virtualization techniques and tools for creating integrated, logical views over disparate data sources without physical consolidation, improving agility and data access.

resources.title: Data Warehouse vs Data Mart vs Data Lake: What's the Difference?
What is Data Virtualization? | Top 10 Data Virtualization Tools | Data Virtualization Tutorial | Simplilearn

tree.name: Batch Data Pipelines
tree.description: Develop skills to build, optimize, and manage batch ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale data ingestion and transformation, ensuring data quality and efficiency.

resources.title: Data Engineering with Python and AI/LLMs (freeCodeCamp)
Apache Airflow Full Course for Data Engineering

children.name: ETL/ELT Concepts & Data Ingestion
children.description: Understand the fundamental differences and trade-offs between ETL and ELT. Learn various methods for ingesting data (e.g., file-based, API integration, database replication, Change Data Capture (CDC), web scraping) and best practices for robust data loading.

resources.title: ETL vs ELT - What's the Difference?
ETL vs ELT Explained (Differences, Benefits, Use Cases) - Data Engineering Basics
Introduction to Data Engineering - Data Ingestion

children.name: Distributed Processing with Apache Spark
children.description: Master Spark architecture, RDDs, DataFrames, Spark SQL, and Structured Streaming. Learn about partitioning, caching, cluster modes, fault tolerance, and performance tuning techniques for large-scale batch and near real-time processing using PySpark.

resources.title: PySpark Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course (2023)

children.name: Data Transformation with dbt
children.description: Utilize dbt (data build tool) for building modular, tested, and documented SQL models. Learn about managing data sources, defining tests, creating repeatable data transformations, and deploying them in a modern data stack with best practices.

resources.title: dbt Tutorial for Beginners - Learn dbt (Data Build Tool) from Scratch

children.name: Data Formats & Compression
children.description: Learn about various data formats (CSV, JSON, XML for raw data; Parquet, ORC, Avro for columnar and row-based storage) and compression techniques (Gzip, Snappy, Zstd) for efficient storage, fast querying, and reduced costs of large datasets in data lakes and warehouses.

resources.title: Parquet, ORC, Avro: What's the Difference for Data Engineers
GZIP vs Snappy vs Zstd Explained | Compression Algorithms for Data Engineers

children.name: Practice Lab: Data Cleansing & Transformation
children.description: Apply learned skills to clean messy real-world datasets, identify and handle missing values, outliers, and inconsistencies. Document assumptions, implement data quality checks, and publish trusted transformed tables ready for analysis or further processing.

resources.title: Data Cleaning in Python with Pandas (Numpy, Matplotlib) - Full Course
Data Cleaning Tutorial | Data Preprocessing in Machine Learning | Missing Values | Feature Scaling

tree.name: Streaming Data Pipelines
tree.description: Build and manage real-time and near-real-time data pipelines using event streaming platforms and stream processing frameworks, handling high throughput and low-latency requirements.

resources.title: The Log: What every software engineer should know about real-time data's unifying abstraction
Apache Kafka Crash Course for Beginners
Apache Flink Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course

children.name: Event Streaming with Apache Kafka
children.description: Deep dive into Kafka concepts: topics, partitions, producers, consumers, consumer groups, offsets, message delivery semantics (at-least-once, exactly-once), schema registries (Avro, Protobuf), Kafka Connect for integration, and Kafka Streams for lightweight processing.

resources.title: Apache Kafka - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Stream Processing Frameworks
children.description: Explore and implement stream processing with frameworks like Apache Flink or Spark Structured Streaming. Learn about windowing operations (tumbling, sliding, session), stateful stream processing, event time vs. processing time, and fault tolerance for real-time transformations and aggregations.

resources.title: Apache Spark Full Course - Learn Apache Spark in 3 Hours | Spark Structured Streaming, PySpark, Spark ML
Apache Flink Tutorial for Beginners | Learn Apache Flink Fundamentals

children.name: Real-time Data Ingestion & APIs
children.description: Understand how to ingest data from various real-time sources, including webhooks, message queues (e.g., AWS SQS/Kinesis, RabbitMQ, Google Pub/Sub), real-time APIs, and integrating with IoT devices for continuous data flows.

resources.title: AWS Kinesis Data Streams Developer Guide
Apache Kafka Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course

children.name: Event-Driven Architecture Patterns
children.description: Deepen understanding of event-driven architectures. Explore patterns such as event sourcing, Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS), saga patterns, and the distinctions between publish-subscribe messaging and message queues in complex distributed systems.

resources.title: Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) Explained - System Design for Beginners
What is Event Sourcing? - System Design Explained

tree.name: Workflow Orchestration & Monitoring
tree.description: Learn to schedule, manage, and monitor complex data workflows, ensuring reliability, data quality, and operational efficiency across diverse environments.

resources.title: The Rise of the Data Orchestration Layer
Apache Airflow Tutorial - Workflow Orchestration with Python

children.name: Workflow Orchestration with Apache Airflow
children.description: Design and implement DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs), manage dependencies, schedule tasks, handle retries, parameterize workflows, and monitor job failures in Airflow. Explore different executors, sensors, and operators for complex pipeline management.

resources.title: Apache Airflow Tutorial for Beginners | Getting Started with Airflow

children.name: Containerization with Docker
children.description: Understand Docker concepts for packaging applications and dependencies into isolated containers. Learn to build Docker images, manage containers, use Docker Compose for multi-container applications, facilitating consistent environments for development and deployment of data pipelines.

resources.title: Docker Crash Course For Absolute Beginners

children.name: CI/CD for Data Pipelines
children.description: Implement Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices for data pipelines. Learn about automated testing (unit, integration, data quality tests), code reviews, versioning data assets, and automated deployments for ensuring reliability, maintainability, and faster iteration cycles.

resources.title: What is CI/CD? Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery
GitHub Actions Tutorial - CI/CD for Beginners

children.name: Monitoring, Logging & Alerting
children.description: Implement robust monitoring for data pipelines and infrastructure, set up proactive alerting for anomalies, performance bottlenecks, and failures (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog). Establish comprehensive logging practices (e.g., ELK stack, cloud logging services) for debugging, auditing, and operational insights.

resources.title: Prometheus & Grafana Tutorial for Beginners | Monitoring Docker
ELK Stack Tutorial for Beginners - Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana (Linux)

tree.name: Cloud Data Platforms, MLOps & Governance
tree.description: Master cloud-native data services, ensure data quality and governance, and understand the data engineer's role in supporting machine learning operations and maintaining production-grade data ecosystems.

resources.title: What is Data Engineering? | The Data Engineer's Role Explained
MLOps for Beginners | Deploy a Machine Learning Model with MLOps

children.name: Cloud Data Platform Ecosystems (AWS/GCP/Azure)
children.description: Explore and compare key data services across major cloud providers (e.g., AWS S3, Glue, Kinesis, Redshift, Athena, EMR; GCP Cloud Storage, Dataflow, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataproc; Azure Data Lake, Data Factory, Synapse, Event Hubs, Databricks on Azure). Focus on service selection, integration patterns, and cost optimization for specific data workloads.

resources.title: AWS vs. Azure vs. GCP: In-Depth Comparison of Cloud Services

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
children.description: Learn to provision and manage cloud infrastructure using declarative tools like Terraform or AWS CloudFormation (or Azure ARM templates, GCP Deployment Manager). Focus on creating reproducible, version-controlled, and automated deployments of data infrastructure.

resources.title: Terraform Course - From BEGINNER to PRO! (Create, Deploy, and Manage AWS Infrastructure)

children.name: Data Quality, Observability & Lineage
children.description: Implement data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, Soda Core, dbt-expectations) to define and enforce data quality rules. Build data observability practices to monitor data health, detect anomalies, and establish data lineage to track data's journey and ensure trust and reliability in data assets.

resources.title: Data Quality, Observability, and Lineage Explained (Data Engineering Explained)
Great Expectations Tutorial | Data Quality with Python

children.name: Data Governance, Security & Privacy
children.description: Understand data governance policies, implement robust security best practices (IAM, encryption, network security, access control), manage Personally Identifiable Information (PII), ensure compliance with regulations (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA), and implement strategies for cloud cost optimization.

resources.title: BigQuery Best Practices for Cost Optimization
What is Data Privacy? (Explained with Examples)

children.name: Introduction to MLOps for Data Engineers
children.description: Understand the data engineer's crucial role in MLOps, including preparing and curating data for model training, building robust feature engineering pipelines, managing feature stores, and deploying/monitoring data components for machine learning systems in production.

resources.title: What is MLOps? Machine Learning Operations Explained

children.name: Data API Design & Serving
children.description: Learn to design and implement robust data APIs (RESTful, GraphQL, gRPC) for serving transformed datasets to analytics tools, applications, or machine learning models. Focus on creating clear data contracts, ensuring efficient access, scalability, and security for data consumers.

resources.title: Building REST APIs with Python Flask
API Design Best Practices for REST APIs
What is GraphQL? A quick overview

children.name: Capstone Project: End-to-End Data Platform
children.description: Design, build, and deploy a complete data pipeline solution, encompassing data ingestion (batch/streaming), transformation, warehousing (data lakehouse), quality checks, workflow orchestration, and a serving layer (APIs or dashboards) for analytics or ML applications using cloud services. Focus on best practices, scalability, and reliability.

resources.title: Public Data Sets for Data Engineering (Kaggle)
How to build an End-to-End Data Pipeline (with Python & AWS)
